descriptionChirho: To move about aimlessly without a fixed dwelling, as a vagabond or exile (Qal intransitive).
To drive someone about as a wanderer or fugitive, to make them roam without rest (Hifil causative of wandering).
To move unsteadily back and forth like a drunkard, a reed in the wind, or something being shaken; includes passive 'be shaken' (Qal/Nifal intransitive).
To shake or shudder involuntarily from fear, awe, or seismic disturbance (Qal intransitive).
To shake or wag something deliberately, especially the head in scorn or derision, or to cause someone to tremble (Hifil transitive/causative).
To shake back and forth as grain in a sieve, to sift or winnow by shaking (Hifil/Nifal metaphorical extension).
